rationale: The original thesis remains fully intact as the stock continues to consolidate constructively in the top decile of its daily range (92.4%) and comfortably above the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($34.08). Recent 1-minute pullback candles occurred on declining volume before finding support right at the $34.10 entry level and turning back up to $34.20. With strong relative strength against a weak broader market and 79 minutes left in the session, holding for a retest of session highs at $34.55 remains the highest-expectancy action.
